definitions.explanation: The inside angle where two walls, sides, or edges meet. An interior corner of a room or space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a bookshelf in the corner of the room.

examples.japanese: {隅|すみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隅|すみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cleaned from corner to corner (thoroughly).

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put it in the corner of the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a book on a quiet bench in a corner of the park.

notes:
{隅|すみ} is an interior corner (a concave angle) or an out-of-the-way spot.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {隅|すみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隅|すみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from corner to corner, thoroughly
- {隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}けない→置く：01092_oku⟧: not to be underestimated (said admiringly of someone with a hidden talent)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧おく: to keep in the back of one's mind
- ⟦{片隅|かたすみ}→片隅：13464_katasumi⟧: a corner; ⟦{隅々|すみずみ}→隅々：16497_sumizumi⟧: every nook and cranny
- ⟦{隅|すみ}っこ→隅っこ：16361_sumikko⟧: corner (casual, cute)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧: exterior corner (a street corner, the edge of a table) — ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ} but ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧

WRITING:
Sometimes written {角|すみ}, which is easily misread as かど or つの; {隅|すみ} is the standard spelling.
